XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Airbag control unit

  • Fault: Airbag warning light illuminated, seatbelt buzzer not functioning and ‘Fuel cut-off not available’ warning displayed on screen

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B10AA (Proxy alignment check)
    • B1022 (On/Off switch audio)
    • U1726 (No communication between instrument cluster and airbag control unit)
  • Cause: Faulty airbag control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the airbag control unit and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, following the replacement of the airbag control unit, proxy alignment was necessary because the odometer started flashing, indicating a misalignment of the CAN network. The defective component did not show any visual abnormalities.
